items.claim: Quillan Salkeld possesses more powerful striking and superior grappling compared to Mateusz Gamrot.
items.quote: AJ, more powerful, more kinetic energy in his shots, and better at grappling.

items.claim: Mateusz Gamrot has shown vulnerability to being buckled by strikes in past fights.
items.quote: And we've seen Gamrot buckle before.

items.claim: Ludovit Klein's grappling is not his strong suit as he is primarily a kickboxer.
items.quote: Ludovit Klein, grappling not his forte. You know, he's a kickboxer.
